data.name: Erkan
data.gender_notes: Erkan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Turkish word 'erkan', meaning'manly' or 'strong'. This name is often given to boys to symbolize courage, strength, and power. The name Erkan carries the meaning “Strong, manly, powerful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Erkan usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, manly, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of inner strength and courage in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Erkan belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, manly, powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Erkan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: עֶרְקָן
in_hebrew.meaning: מקורו מערבי, פירוש: בעל כוח חזק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם עֶרְקָן נובע ממקור ערבי, שם זה נמצא במקורות עתיקים. הפירוש המדויק הוא "בעל כוח חזק". בעולם האסלאמי, השם עֶרְקָן הוצג ככוח חזק וכמנהיג. במסורת הנוצרית, ניתן לצפות לאזכרות דומות. זהו שם המתאים לילד קורע-דף, שנולד לעשות שם.

in_greek.name: Ἐρκάν
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἐρκάν (Ἀρκάν) ἔχουν τοὺς τίτλους ἑαυτούς ἐκ τοῦ Ἕβραϊκού. Ἡ ἀρχική ἕρμηνεία, σαφής, ἐστὶ συνώνυμε ἀπὸ τὴν Ἕβραϊκή γλώσσα. Ἐν Ἀραβικὲν, ἡ παλιότεν μορφή, Ἐρκαν, ἔχει ἐπίγνωσιν σὰν ἡγέτη ἢ ἀνδρικὴν ἰδιότητα. Ἀναλογικὰ, στὸ Νεοελληνικὸ, ἡ ἕρμηνεία, σαφής, ἔχει ἐπίγνωσιν σὰν ἀνδρικὴν ἰδιότητα. Ἐν συντομία, ἡ ἕρμηνεία σαφής ἐστὶ σὰν ἕνας ἀνδρικὸς τίτλος.

in_latin.name: Erkanus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Erkanus originem habet ex lingua Arabica, significans virum fortissimum. In mundo Islamico, nomen Erkanus depictus est ut vir fortis et dux. In traditione Christiana, potestis expectare mementos similes. Hoc nomen aptum est ad puerum qui natus est ut faciat nomen suum.
